
{{alias}}( x, y, z )
    Returns sqrt( x^2 + y^2 + z^2 ) in a manner which doesn't cause unnecessary
    overflow.

    If either argument is `NaN` and the other argument is not `+-Infinity`,
    the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        First number.

    y: number
        Second number.

    z: number
        Third number.

    Returns
    -------
    out: number
        Sqrt( x^2 + y^2 + z^2 ).

    Examples
    --------
    > var h = {{alias}}( 3.0, 4.0, 12.0 )
    13.0
    > h = {{alias}}( NaN, 12.0, 0.0 )
    NaN
    > h = {{alias}}( -0.0, -0.0, 0.0 )
    0.0

    See Also
    --------
